verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an email delivery service, since buyers do compare hosted and self-hostable options, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Mailgun offering a self-hostable or on-prem version. The one community mention of a 'self-hosting option' (mailgun-comm-16) describes running your own mail infrastructure instead of using Mailgun, not hosting Mailgun itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
